## Checklist

- [ ] I changed only my catalog entry unless a maintainer requested other changes.
- [ ] I own this game or have permission to distribute this trial.
- [ ] Trial works on current iOS Safari and Android Chrome with touch controls.
- [ ] Trial URL uses HTTPS and allows cross-origin Unity/WebAssembly asset requests.
- [ ] Trial starts without login, payment, wallet connection, or automatic audio.
- [ ] Destination URL and action label accurately describe the player’s next step.
- [ ] Trial contains no prohibited, deceptive, or unlicensed content.
- [ ] `estimatedDownloadMb` includes loader, data, framework, and WebAssembly files.
- [ ] `node scripts/validate-games.mjs` passes locally.
